source_title: Failure Investigation Report – Denbury Gulf Coast Pipelines LLC (26 May 2022)
extracted_text: The CO₂ was heavier than air and followed a path downhill. CO₂ moved down the slope to the east and remained in the bowl of the crater. As the discharged volume increased, and without significant winds to disperse the CO₂, the CO₂ moved over the crest of the hill then west into the valley, reaching Satartia.
